title: Wit Laced Glassy-Jelly Oat Milk Bake
description: A festive Ethiopian-inspired bake featuring a bitter glassy-jelly, pescatarian-friendly and perfect for form=kitfo enthusiasts.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the gelatin and 0.25 cups of water, letting it bloom for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine the oat milk, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, citric acid, and cocoa nibs (if using).
Heat the mixture over medium heat, whisking occasionally, until the sugar dissolves and the mixture simmers.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the dissolved gelatin mixture, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then transfer it to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap, pressing the wrap directly onto the surface of the mixture to prevent a skin from forming.
Refrigerate the mixture for at least 3 hours, or overnight, until it sets and develops a glassy-jelly texture.
Before serving, sprinkle the toasted Wit (Ethiopian cardamom) over the top of the bake, if desired.
Cut the bake into small squares and serve chilled.
